Labour Market Report - August 2026

Date published: 18 August 2026

Statistics: Labour Market Overview,  Labour Force Survey,  Claimant Count,  Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings,  Redundancies,  Quarterly Employment Survey,  Labour Market Survey

The LMR provides a monthly overview of key NI labour market statistics, including data from the LFS, QES, claimant count, redundancies, and HMRC PAYE.
